title: Site social media icons
slide_intent: Show how a distinctive detail can stand in for a full venue name when a platform reduces a profile image to a small circle.
strategic_value: The venues can carry their individual line devices and colors into social accounts while retaining a shared icon format.
demonstration: Six labeled circular icons pair each venue color with a line detail from its mark. The text specifies 180 px square source files for platforms that crop profiles into circles.
practical_value: Use the site-specific icon for a venue account and preserve its color and line motif through the circular crop.

content_islands.spec: Set the page heading and note about source size and cropping at left.

content_islands.name: Venue icon family
content_islands.spec: Arrange the six icons in two rows of three at equal scale. Label each with its venue name so the reader can match line detail and color to the site.
